cases.goldenText:
The schema error in the linked thread is unrelated to the original failure, the two just went briefly out of sync.

I am still seeing the old view on the staging account, so I am not sure whether this is the thing that was reported broken.

The runbook in Notion says a rebuild is needed after a migration, which would explain the drift.
cases.paraphrase:
That schema error is a separate problem, nothing to do with the first one. The two had drifted apart for a bit and went out of sync.

Checked staging and the old layout is still rendering, so I cannot confirm it is the same fault anyone flagged.

Our Notion runbook wants a rebuild once a migration lands, which fits what we are seeing.

cases.goldenText:
Nothing in the corpus records an on-call payment policy.

I checked the obvious wordings and the thirty closest hits were all about coverage rosters and paging behaviour, none of them about money.

That is only as good as the wordings I tried, so treat it as not found rather than not existing.

Worth asking whoever owns the roster, I do not think we have ever written it down.
